scoreMethod.label: Score /100
scoreMethod.note: Weighted for NovaHair's primary Israel objective: economics 35%, Israel shipping fit 20%, MOQ/prestock flexibility 15%, product/shade fit 15%, integration/fulfillment 10%, responsiveness 5%.

waitingOnHarel.title: Decide whether a Netherlands pilot is worth pursuing
waitingOnHarel.detail: France → Netherlands economics are roughly €13.18–€13.38/order before storage (€11.08 UPS + €1.50 fulfillment + €0.60–€0.80 carton). This does not solve Israel, but it is a credible EU expansion route.
waitingOnHarel.action: If Netherlands is a near-term market, move to a small operational test. Correct their mistaken assumption about the billing entity before onboarding.

waitingOnHarel.title: Israel quote would require product/regulatory documents
waitingOnHarel.detail: Packstack says Israel is not a core market, requires at least 200 orders per market per month, and would need product details such as HS code/SDS before properly assessing Israel.
waitingOnHarel.action: Decide whether it is worth sharing the required product documentation later; otherwise park Israel and keep Packstack only as a possible EU option.

waitingOnHarel.title: Decide whether to park the custom-development route
waitingOnHarel.detail: Their custom grey-coverage route is approximately $15,000–$20,000 for development plus the first 2,000-unit run, with full upfront payment and no DTC fulfillment or Shopify/API integration.
waitingOnHarel.action: No commitment has been made. Only continue if this budget and operating model are intentionally acceptable; otherwise close/park the lead.

suppliers.name: BODA Haircare
suppliers.latest: Factory offer: $1.50 per 200ml at 500 pcs/color; at least 6 colors. 12 shades available. They said they can ship directly to customers and are checking the 4-bottle DHL/air cost.
suppliers.economics: Product looks attractive; shipping still unknown.
suppliers.prestock: 50% deposit; inventory can be split into 3 shipments over 6 months; warehousing otherwise
suppliers.integration: Direct customer shipping possible; Shopify/API not yet confirmed
suppliers.next: Get exact 4 × 200ml Israel shipping cost + transit time and confirm fulfillment workflow/API.
suppliers.risk: Large initial commitment and 50% deposit; no commitment has been made.

suppliers.name: Yogi Cosmetics
suppliers.latest: Professional China hair-color manufacturer. They do not do one-piece fulfillment but can manufacture and send bulk inventory to a China fulfillment warehouse.
suppliers.moq: Quote requested for 500 and 1,000 total with mixed shades if possible
suppliers.prestock: Asked whether ~30% partial deposit / prestock is possible
suppliers.integration: Would rely on external China 3PL for Shopify orders, packing and shipping
suppliers.next: Wait for manufacturing price, mixed-shade MOQ, lead time and recommended fulfillment partner.
suppliers.risk: Two-vendor setup adds operational complexity.

suppliers.name: EcomPrep Hub
suppliers.latest: France → Netherlands UPS shown around €11.08 for ~1kg. Fulfillment €1.50/order, carton €0.60–€0.80, receiving free, storage €15/m³/month. No platform fee or minimum commitment. Shopify + tracking sync supported.
suppliers.economics: Approx. €13.18–€13.38/order + storage for Netherlands, before any entity-specific tax treatment.
suppliers.integration: Shopify integration + order processing + tracking sync
suppliers.next: Only pursue if Netherlands/EU is a real near-term market; Israel route is not competitive.
suppliers.risk: EU-only opportunity for now; supplier also assumed a different billing entity.

suppliers.name: LAEYO
suppliers.verdict: Product fit looks credible; operating model is less flexible
suppliers.latest: Stock-bottle MOQ is 2,000 bottles; custom bottles are 5,000–10,000. They do not provide Israel DTC fulfillment or Shopify integration. Exact EXW price, shade split and Israel freight are still pending.
suppliers.economics: Unit price not yet provided; bulk freight to Israel requested.
suppliers.moq: 2,000 bottles using stock bottle; 5,000–10,000 for custom bottle
suppliers.prestock: Standard term stated as 50% deposit with balance before shipment; lower-deposit/prestock option requested
suppliers.integration: No direct Israel DTC fulfillment or Shopify integration
suppliers.next: Get actual EXW unit price, shade-split rule, bulk freight/transit time and any lower-MOQ/lower-deposit alternative.
suppliers.risk: MOQ and deposit structure are materially less flexible than the current dropship model.

suppliers.name: ASG Dropshipping
suppliers.verdict: Workflow fit, current shipping still fails economics
suppliers.latest: Revised quote: $7 product + $53.64 shipping = $60.64 delivered for 4 bottles, based on 1.7kg, with 6–10 working days delivery. Shopify/order/tracking sync is available.
suppliers.economics: $60.64 delivered for 4 bottles — improved from the first quote, but still far above the current ~$34.13 benchmark.
suppliers.moq: No DTC MOQ stated; prestock proposal is based on 100 orders / 400 bottles
suppliers.prestock: They proposed prepaying 100 orders / 400 bottles; a partial-deposit alternative was requested and not accepted yet
suppliers.integration: Shopify/order/tracking sync through their OMS; API details requested
suppliers.next: Wait for a cheaper tracked Israel line, true packed-weight review, prestock pick/pack economics and partial-deposit alternative.
suppliers.risk: Shipping remains the economic blocker; prestock proposal requires too much prepayment.

suppliers.name: Private Labels Hair Products
suppliers.latest: MOQ stated as 1,000 units per reference/shade. Asked whether 1,000 can be mixed across shades or whether an existing-stock formula has a lower MOQ.
suppliers.economics: Unit price and shipping still pending.
suppliers.next: Wait for mixed-color MOQ, 200ml price, shades, lead time and Israel fulfillment answer.
suppliers.risk: Per-shade MOQ could make a multi-color launch uneconomic.

suppliers.name: Junchen Cosmetics / KertaineQueen
suppliers.verdict: Possible manufacturer; needs economics and external fulfillment
suppliers.latest: They manufacture hair-care and hair-color products but do not offer DTC dropshipping, individual-order inventory holding or Shopify/API synchronization. Quote requested for their closest existing true grey-coverage 200ml product.
suppliers.economics: Requested pricing at 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 bottles plus bulk freight to Israel.
suppliers.moq: Pending; tiered quote requested at 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 bottles
suppliers.integration: No DTC or Shopify/API; would require an external Israeli or China 3PL
suppliers.next: Wait for unit prices, shades, mixed-shade MOQ, production time, freight and any 3PL introduction.
suppliers.risk: Bulk-only model adds a second operational partner and inventory commitment.

suppliers.name: Versandmanufaktur
suppliers.latest: Their helpdesk auto-closed the ticket while the request was under internal review. It was reopened/contested and the full quote request was repeated.
suppliers.next: Wait for actual Israel quote.
suppliers.risk: Slow/unclear support process.

suppliers.name: Chantal
suppliers.verdict: R&D quote pending; DTC model does not fit directly
suppliers.latest: They do not send small DTC parcels. Their R&D team is costing an existing dark-shade / grey-coverage route after clarification that true grey coverage is required. They said to allow about 2 working days for costing.
suppliers.economics: Pending R&D quotation and bulk freight economics.
suppliers.moq: Dosage service around 3,000 pcs; mixing MOQ depends on product, with hair-dye bulk figures much higher for custom work
suppliers.integration: No DTC fulfillment; external Israeli 3PL would be required
suppliers.next: Wait for R&D quote on an existing ready formula, lowest MOQ, shades and bulk freight to Israel.
suppliers.risk: Custom-development MOQs are too large; only an existing formula is potentially viable.

suppliers.name: Packstack
suppliers.status: Blocked for Israel pending documents / volume
suppliers.verdict: Possible EU partner; weak Israel fit
suppliers.latest: Netherlands fulfillment is possible, but they require at least 200 orders per market per month. Israel is not a core market and they indicated HS code/SDS would be needed before a proper assessment.
suppliers.moq: At least 200 orders per market per month
suppliers.prestock: Can hold supplied inventory; final fees not established
suppliers.next: Only provide product documentation if the Israel route remains worth pursuing; otherwise keep for future EU expansion.
suppliers.risk: Israel is outside their core network and requires additional product/regulatory documentation.

suppliers.name: B&W Co-Creations
suppliers.verdict: Private label is acceptable; economics unknown
suppliers.latest: They initially declined because they only do private label rather than white label. We clarified that private label is acceptable and requested a rough quote. Their contact is out of office through 4 October and email is only being read sporadically.
suppliers.economics: Pending indicative 200ml quote and Israel freight.
suppliers.next: Wait for a substantive answer after 4 October; avoid duplicate follow-up before then unless necessary.
suppliers.risk: Slow timing due to vacation; product fit not yet confirmed.

suppliers.name: WAPI
suppliers.latest: Confirmed they do not deliver to Israel and ship exclusively across the EU.
suppliers.prestock: Potentially relevant only for future EU expansion
suppliers.next: No Israel action. Revisit only if EU expansion becomes active.
suppliers.risk: Does not serve the current core market.

suppliers.name: Hongshin Cosmetics
suppliers.verdict: MOQ per SKU is high for a multi-shade launch
suppliers.latest: Their standard minimum is 1,500 units per SKU for Taiwan production and 3,000 units per SKU for South Korea, with each SKU carrying its own minimum.
suppliers.economics: No usable NovaHair delivered quote yet.
suppliers.next: Only continue if they can offer an existing grey-coverage formula with mixed-shade economics materially below normal SKU minimums.
suppliers.risk: Per-shade MOQ is likely uneconomic for the current Israel launch model.

suppliers.name: HairODM / Yuki
suppliers.verdict: No current route to the required product
suppliers.latest: HairODM does not currently have the required NovaHair product. The external agent they suggested does not operate on a purchasing/sourcing model, so that route is also closed for now.
suppliers.moq: Wholesale haircare can be 1 carton/SKU; private label typically 1,000 pcs/SKU, but not for the required product today
suppliers.integration: No viable external sourcing/fulfillment route from the suggested agent
suppliers.next: No action; reopen only if they proactively confirm a true grey-coverage product becomes available.
suppliers.risk: Does not solve the core product requirement.

suppliers.name: BFF Cosmetics
suppliers.latest: Confirmed they cannot support the required manufacturing + DTC fulfillment / Shopify workflow.
suppliers.next: No action.
suppliers.risk: No fit.

suppliers.name: Private Label Dynamics
suppliers.verdict: Technically possible but far from current operating model
suppliers.latest: No ready true grey-coverage shampoo. Custom development plus the first 2,000-unit run is estimated around $15,000–$20,000. They do not provide DTC fulfillment or Shopify/API integration.
suppliers.economics: Approximately $15,000–$20,000 total for development + first 2,000 units; exact unit price only after formulation.
suppliers.prestock: Full upfront payment required before production; no long-term finished-goods holding
suppliers.integration: No DTC fulfillment or Shopify/API integration
suppliers.next: Do not commit. Decide whether the custom-development budget is intentionally in scope; otherwise park the lead.
suppliers.risk: Large upfront commitment, custom-development risk and no fulfillment integration.

suppliers.name: Girasol Natural Products
suppliers.verdict: Normal MOQ is far above current needs
suppliers.latest: Their normal production can start around 10,000 pieces / 100L / 210kg per SKU depending on the project. Custom development can cost up to about €5,000 for the base formula plus €1,000 per extra variant. We asked them to first confirm whether a ready/white-label true grey-coverage formula exists.
suppliers.economics: No viable ready-formula quote yet; custom development is expensive.
suppliers.moq: Typical minimums around 10,000 pieces or large bulk batches depending on format
suppliers.prestock: Pending; not relevant unless a lower-MOQ ready formula exists
suppliers.next: Wait only for confirmation of an existing ready grey-coverage formula with materially lower MOQ.
suppliers.risk: Normal development route is too large and costly for the current objective.

suppliers.name: Onoxa
suppliers.latest: They only ship within the U.S., customization is label-only, and they do not currently offer a grey-coverage product.
suppliers.moq: Low-MOQ model generally, but no suitable product
suppliers.next: No action.
suppliers.risk: Does not offer the required product and does not ship to Israel.

suppliers.name: Fulando
suppliers.latest: They are currently at full capacity and cannot take on new clients.
suppliers.next: No action unless capacity reopens later.
suppliers.risk: Unavailable operationally.

suppliers.name: FULLY Cosmetics
suppliers.latest: They said their MOQ is significantly higher than the current requirement and they do not offer dropshipping, warehousing/prestock, direct-to-customer Israel fulfillment or Shopify/order sync, so they declined the project.
suppliers.moq: Above current requirement; exact usable level not offered
suppliers.next: No action.
suppliers.risk: No fit with current volume or fulfillment model.

suppliers.name: MAG Cosmetics
suppliers.verdict: MOQ and operating model do not fit
suppliers.latest: They declined the project. Existing formulations require 5,000 units per SKU and new formulations 20,000 units per SKU. They do not offer inventory holding, DTC fulfillment or Shopify/API order fulfillment and supply EXW Germany.
suppliers.moq: 5,000 units/SKU existing formula; 20,000 units/SKU new development
suppliers.next: No action.
suppliers.risk: MOQ is far above current needs and there is no fulfillment layer.

suppliers.name: Eurodor
suppliers.latest: They explicitly said they cannot provide the required hair-dye shampoo manufacturing or direct-to-customer Israel fulfillment services.
suppliers.next: No action.
suppliers.risk: No fit.

suppliers.name: RainShadow Labs
suppliers.latest: They clarified that they do not manufacture hair-color products.
suppliers.next: No action for NovaHair.
suppliers.risk: Product-category mismatch.

suppliers.name: ABBE Laboratories
suppliers.latest: They specialize in skin care and do not work with hair color.
suppliers.next: No action for NovaHair.
suppliers.risk: Product-category mismatch.

outreachCampaigns.name: Expansion Wave 01
outreachCampaigns.focus: Hair-color / grey-coverage shampoo + haircare/skincare/beauty trend intelligence
outreachCampaigns.asks: Pricing, shades, MOQ, lead time, prestock/partial-deposit options, DTC fulfillment, Shopify/API, market-ready documentation and top 3–5 growing product categories.
